name: linear_backward
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linear_backward(Tensor self, Tensor grad_output, Tensor weight, bool[3] output_mask) -> (Tensor, Tensor, Tensor). Computes selected input, weight, and bias gradients for a linear layer according to a three-element output mask. Tests cover full and partial masks including all-false, multidimensional batches, None outputs, gradient metadata, input non-mutation, and invalid mask length.
